body:
Follow-up to `robofab-jawcap` (its "joint-speed limit" next step), track `robofab`. Adds a peak joint-speed limit to the torque and jaw-force limits; time-optimal carry is 28 to 46% shorter than min-jerk under speed limits of 6 to 1 rad/s, tending to the 47% set by the min-jerk profile shape. Stylised, assumed parameters. 29 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok.

Also checked the queue: no open PRs; `claude/simdesign-gaugepockets` duplicates `simdesign-pocketmesh` (already on main), so it was not landed.
